scheme_name: PVTGs Dakia Yojana (Chief Minister's Food Security Scheme)
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).
Applicant’s family must be enrolled under the Antyodaya Yojana.
Family should reside in designated PVTG areas or remote locations.
benefits_summary: Provides 35 kg of wheat and rice per family per month at a subsidised rate of ₹1 per kg.
